status: architecture recommendation; no application implementation or production action

source.model_validation_limit: kalshi_probability_learning.py:496: old mismatched-source forecasts receive structural validation but are not recomputed using current model

scope: new child-only probability epoch host; strict learner restore remains unchanged; no V1/live/control/financial change
identity_rule: Add new host source file to existing SOURCE_FILES. Source changes remain real new measurement identities. No hardcoded historical alias, source rewrite or disabled-state reenable.

state_contract.learning_probability: Immutable deep copy of original VALIDATED legacy checkpoint, frozen once on first host installation; root existing key remains archival.

learning_probability_epochs.legacy_sha256: canonical JSON digest of frozen root legacy state; checksum is consistency evidence, not authenticity proof
learning_probability_epochs.archived: ordered immutable complete records with ordinal, source/protocol identity, opened_at nullable only for imported legacy, closed_at, complete original state, canonical state digest
learning_probability_epochs.active: one ordinal after archives, current actual fingerprint, opened_at, current ProbabilityLearning state
learning_probability_epochs.error: fixed allowlisted host error or null

state_contract.duplicate_legacy: Simplest schema may store legacy both in root old key and archive0; count duplicated bytes in budget. Do not silently change archival root key on later epochs.
state_contract.bounds: Suggested max4 archived+1 active, total serialized optional envelope+duplicated legacy <=2MiB, each state retains existing262144-byte limit. No eviction. At cap refuse next rollout, retain all existing records and disable optional observation. Bound panel separately.

restore_rules: Fresh truly absent arena checkpoint can bootstrap a new empty observer; loaded checkpoint missing both probability history keys must fail optional observer closed instead of pretending first install.
Present null legacy state is invalid. Existing wrapper envelope is authoritative: never fall back to legacy or create zero active state if envelope is malformed/missing active.

Before mutating host, validate schema, exact key sets, bounds, ordinals, identities, timestamps, digests and each learner state. Use a disposable current-source ProbabilityLearning.restore; check restore_rejected, validated identity and ORIGINAL raw status. Retain original deep copy, never probe.state(): probe changes last_at/error/restart annotations.
Require same known prediction PROTOCOL for automatic rollout. A protocol/schema change requires explicit supported migration; generic mismatched string acceptance is not migration authority.

New epoch allowed only from validated history with original restore_rejected=false and either enabled=true/error=null or enabled=false/error=source_or_protocol_mismatch. Other error latches must remain disabled even though current restore may replace their displayed error with mismatch.

When active source equals current source, strict restore normal active state. Do not create another epoch or zero bins on routine restart. ProbabilityLearning constructor gets this restart's now; persisted epoch.opened_at is metadata only.

When source differs and capacity allows, freeze exact validated active raw as next archive; create entirely new ProbabilityLearning(now), zero counts/bins/scores/watermark/labels/pending/raw-batch state. Nothing from prior epoch trains new epoch.
Rollback A->B->A creates ordinal2 with fresh empty A observer; never select old archive by source hash. Old pending forecasts remain frozen/unresolved and never get scored under new source.

Malformed/capacity cases cannot throw into arena restore/reset. Preserve validated legacy and previously committed valid archive state; do not seed fresh active. Display unavailable/disabled current evidence, not fabricated zero performance. Unsafe malformed raw cannot be copied into strict JSON output and cause whole-arena save failure.
On cap rejection keep the existing bounded envelope intact and latch a fixed host error; no archive eviction, rolling aggregate, dropped-oldest counter or automatic disk edits.
integration: Retain ProbabilityLearning as active model; wrapper handles only startup, checkpoint and lineage panel. Explicit forwarding/allowlist for discover/batch/batch_complete/labels_received/advance/status/disable; archived objects never receive runtime callbacks.

Avoid dynamic property mutation or generic call forwarding that hides existing tests/introspection. Arena can retain learning_probability pointing to active learner and separate host for state/restore/panel; wrapper updates pointer once at init only.

Existing panel learning_probability remains current-only and satisfies strict current/history identity equality. Add separate numeric allowlisted lineage panel: current ordinal and archive identity/count/Brier/pending summaries with frozen labels. No cross-epoch score/count sums or promoted best-epoch choice.

Keep save ordering/frequency/durability and parent ArenaLink untouched. Optional host errors cannot reset residents, V1, trade state or finances. Full resource replay must include maximum retained-history serialization before release.
acceptance: Migrate synthetic old5scored/1unknown exactly: deep-equal archival state; fresh active0forecasts/0scored/nullBrier/empty bins; old and new sources distinct.
Original mismatch-disabled state accepted only as validated archive; malformed status, restore_rejected=true, raw_stream_invalid and label_conflict cannot become a new enabled observer.
Missing whole file vs loaded missing keys vs explicit null vs malformed authoritative envelope vs missing active vs altered legacy digest have distinct conservative outcomes.
Restart same source after scoring preserves current bins/counts; pending forecast gains existing child_restart_gap; started-inside window excluded; no second migration.
A->B->A produces3 separate ordinals with fresh bins for finalA; no resurrection, merge, sample relabel or backfill.

Boundary count/byte capacity and one-over refuse atomically, retaining every validated state. Nonfinite/cyclic or oversized fixture cannot break arena serialization; page cannot leak arbitrary strings or raw archive states.

Archive mutation, duplicate ordinal, truncated history, inconsistent source/protocol fields, reversed timestamps and negative/impossible counters fail closed. Unrecognized prediction protocol does not auto-migrate.
Full page/arena baseline isolation across state saves: apart from new optional epoch fields and current probability panel, V1/resident/financial bytes and write ordering/durability unchanged.
Fingerprint dependency preflight proves host changes change source and reports affected persisted identities before deployment; no observed calibration score implies profit.
capture_and_release: Continue existing PR65 capture unchanged while building offline; current observer remains honestly disabled with5old scores retained. Current runtime has no safe activation interface. After fixed capture/tail, use one separately declared tested source release and a newly frozen future observer window; do not extend or restart source-fix capture retroactively.
